projects.project_name: Fake News Prediction Using Machine Learning
projects.description: Developed a fake news detection system using ML algorithms (Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression) and NLP techniques. Processed and cleaned large text datasets, applying TF-IDF feature extraction. Improved accuracy through model tuning and validation, enabling effective misinformation detection.
